about_short_description.short_description: Helicone is an open-source observability platform for generative AI.

product.name: Helicone LLM Observability Platform
product.description: An open-source platform for monitoring, debugging, and improving large language model (LLM) applications in production environments.

product.name: Helicone Self-Hosting
product.description: A deployment option allowing users to run Helicone's observability platform within their own infrastructure using a simplified Docker setup.

product.name: Helicone Sessions
product.description: A feature that traces and visualizes multi-step workflows and decision paths of AI agents and LLM applications for debugging and optimization.

product.name: Helicone Prompt Management and Experimentation
product.description: Tools for managing, testing, and comparing different prompt versions to improve AI application output quality and consistency.

product.name: Helicone LLM API Pricing Calculator
product.description: An open-source tool that estimates and compares costs of using various large language model APIs across multiple providers and models.

product.name: Helicone Gateway Features
product.description: A set of API gateway capabilities including caching, rate limiting, moderation, and fallback mechanisms to manage LLM API usage and improve reliability.
